english.title: False statement in connection with application for street trading licence / consent
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), in connection with an application for a street trading

(A)_[licence,]_
(B)_[consent,]_

made a false statement, namely **(..SPECIFY..), which you knew to be false in a material respect or did not believe to be true
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 10(3) and (4) of Schedule 4 to the Local Government (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1982.
